name: Composer
label: Composer
description: An auto-growing message input with send and stop states, a page-context note, a file tray fed by picker, paste and drop, and Enter-to-send.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value for controlled use. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the value directly.
Fires alongside `onChange`, which keeps the standard React event signature
so form libraries work unmodified.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Fires with the current value on Enter (without Shift) and on the send
button — never while `streaming`, never while a file in `files` is
still uploading, and never when there is nothing to send. Text is
enough, and so is a ready file on its own, in which case the value is
an empty string. Composer does not clear the value: the consumer owns
it and clears it after a successful submit. Shadows the native
`onSubmit` attribute, which never fires on a textarea anyway.

props.name: streaming
props.description:
A response is streaming: the send button becomes a stop button, submit
is blocked, and Enter is inert. On a glowing composer (`aiGlow`) the
gradient ring also stays lit and keeps turning while this is true.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Fires when the stop button is pressed while `streaming`.

props.name: size
props.description: The density, matching a table's or a bar's: `compact` tightens the padding and takes the smaller text and buttons.

props.name: inline
props.description: One row with the send button on the text's line, the shell exactly `size`'s control height, so it lines up with an Input or a table's toolbar. For a popover, a sheet or a tight bar. `maxRows` defaults to 1; above it, typing grows the shell with the send button held in the bottom corner. A placeholder stays on one line and ends in an ellipsis.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Growth cap in text rows before the textarea scrolls internally. Defaults to 8, or 1 when `inline`.

props.name: aiGlow
props.description:
While focused, the shell wears AiButton's slowly rotating gradient ring
and glow in place of the plain selected border — the system's "a model
answers here" signal, for composers whose messages are answered by one.
While `streaming`, the ring stays lit and turning whether or not the
field holds focus. Off by default.

props.name: context
props.description:
Contextual note rendered as a full-width, non-interactive chip — the
"what the model is looking at" line a chat host pins over the message
("Looking at “Page name”"). `contextPlacement` decides where it sits.
One line: a note too long for the shell truncates with an ellipsis.
Composer owns the chip's chrome; the caller passes the text.

props.name: contextPlacement
props.description:
Where the `context` chip sits. `inside` (the default) pins it at the very
top of the shell, above any attachments. `above` lifts it out of the
shell into its own bar a small gap above it, so it reads as what the
model can see rather than part of the message being typed. Either way
its icon starts on the shell's text rail, and a click on it focuses the
textarea.

props.name: contextIcon
props.description:
Icon at the left of the context chip — Material Symbol name (string,
e.g. `visibility`, `article`) or custom element (ReactNode). Decorative
and hidden from assistive technology — the chip's text carries the
meaning. None by default, matching the ai set's icon-free-unless-asked
convention.

props.name: files
props.description:
The files queued on this message, drawn as a scrolling row of square
tiles above the textarea. Controlled by the caller: Composer draws the
list and reports what was added or removed, and never stores a file.
`useAttachments` is the usual owner.

props.name: onFilesSelected
props.description:
Fires with the files a person picked, pasted or dropped. Providing it
arms all three: the attach button and its picker, file paste in the
textarea, and drop on the shell.

props.name: onFileRemove
props.description: Fires with the id of the file whose remove button was pressed. Its presence renders the buttons.

props.name: onFileClick
props.description: Fires with a queued file when its tile is pressed. Its presence makes the tiles buttons.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types the picker offers, in the native `accept` syntax.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether the picker allows several files at once.

props.name: attachButton
props.description: Whether the built-in attach button shows when `onFilesSelected` is set.

props.name: pasteThreshold
props.description:
Pasted text at least this many characters long becomes an attachment
instead of landing in the textarea. Off unless set, and inert without
`onPasteAsAttachment`.

props.name: onPasteAsAttachment
props.description: Receives pasted text that met `pasteThreshold`.

props.name: attachLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the attach button.

props.name: dropLabel
props.description: Text shown on the shell while files are dragged over it.

props.name: filesLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the list of queued files.

props.name: attachmentTileLabels
props.description:
The words each queued file's tile writes, merged over the tile's English
defaults: its status lines ("Uploading…", "Upload failed", "Unavailable"),
its progress spinner's name, and its remove button's name, which is given
the file name and defaults to "Remove" followed by it.

props.name: formatFileAnnouncement
props.description:
Builds the sentence announced to assistive technology when files join
the queue, leave it, or fail.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Free-form row rendered above the textarea, after any `files`.
props.deprecated: Use `files` with `onFilesSelected` and `onFileRemove`, which draw the queue as tiles.

props.name: mentions
props.description:
What a person can reference while typing, one source per trigger
character: `@` for entities, `/` for skills. Typing a trigger at the
start of a word opens a menu of that source's items, filtered as the
word grows. Arrows move through it, Enter or Tab writes the choice into
the text, Escape closes it. A mention is drawn in the tag colour
wherever its exact name stands in the text; the value stays a plain
string.

props.name: onMentionSelect
props.description: Fires with the item a person chose from the mention menu, and the trigger that opened it.

props.name: mentionPlacement
props.description:
Which side of the trigger's line the mention menu opens on: `top` lays
it over the text above, `bottom` over the text below. `top` suits a
composer at the foot of a view.

props.name: formatMentionAnnouncement
props.description: Builds the sentence announced to assistive technology when the mention menu opens or its matches change.

props.name: actions
props.description: Leading actions on the left of the action bar, after the attach button (a model picker).

props.name: trailingActions
props.description:
Trailing actions on the right of the action bar, just before the send
button (dictation, voice mode).

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the send button.

props.name: stopLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the stop button.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale file sizes are written in, such as `de-DE` (`1,5 MB`). Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the shell, not the <textarea>.
